title: Detection-as-Code lab result record
description: One record per execution run. A run is either a malicious atomic execution or a single baseline run. Every published metric must trace back to one or more of these rows in results/runs.csv.

run_id.description: Unique id for this run, e.g. 2026-11-10T09-14-32Z_T1059.001_r1

technique_id.description: ATT&CK id for malicious runs; 'baseline' for baseline runs

atomic_status.description: Did the atomic executor actually run the test? 'na' for baseline runs. A coverage score is never derived from a run whose atomic did not execute.

telemetry_present.description: Did the expected Sysmon event appear in Wazuh archives for this run's window?

expected_sysmon_events.description: Sysmon event IDs hypothesized for this technique

observed_sysmon_events.description: Sysmon event IDs actually seen in the window

detected.description: Did any lab rule raise an alert for this run?

rule_id.description: Wazuh rule_id that fired (the primary one, if several)

alert_count.description: Number of alerts this rule raised in the run window. For baseline runs this is the FP contribution of rule_id.

latency_s.description: alert_time - t_start, seconds. Null if not detected.

coverage_score.description: 0-3 per evaluation-protocol §2.1. Assigned per technique after its 3 malicious runs; may be left per-run-null and computed in aggregation.

tuning_pass.description: 0 = pre-tuning, 1 = after first tuning pass, etc.
